messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: p99 latency spike detected for tenant \"Orion Logistics\" (org: orion-123) in eu-west-1 dedicated pool. p95 320ms -> 1.8s, p99 1.9s -> 8.5s. Trigger: latency_slo_breach. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/latency/orion-123
marie (oncall): ack — paging now. creating incident channel and adding stakeholders. @sahil @jen please join. :rotating_light:
sahil: joining. seeing CPU on pool-ord-3 at 92% and host qdepth spike. baseline RPS unchanged. suspect KV cache thrashing. dumping tail logs now.
jen: on it. can we isolate tenant to a different sub-pool or reduce weight? we have routing policies but need a quick lift.
eng-infra: can enable burst-capacity for the dedicated pool, adding 2 GPU nodes (estimate 3m). also can nudge autoscaler up by 30%. issuing changes now.
ops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-isolation
Quick commands:
```
# move tenant traffic
rwdctl routes move --tenant orion-123 --from pool=dedicated-eu1 --to pool=spillover-eu1
# enable burst
rwdctl pools update dedicated-eu1 --burst enable --burst-nodes 2
```
sahil: logs: several clients sending long-context batches >8k tokens, KV-cache miss rate jumped 4% -> 27%. one job (orion-batch-worker) repeatedly reopening long sessions. throttling that job will help.
marie (oncall): jen, reduce orion weight to 0.2 in routing policy but do it gradually so we don't drop in-flight requests. also CS to notify customer.
jen: doing weight change now:
`rwdctl routes set-weight --tenant orion-123 --pool dedicated-eu1 --weight 0.2`
jen: done. observed p95 down to ~700ms within 30s. p99 still ~1.6s but trending down.
cs-rep: pinging Orion oncall — sending status: \"We see elevated latencies in eu-west-1 dedicated pool; we have reduced your traffic weight and enabled burst nodes. ETA stabilization 10-15m.\" :email:
platform-lead: taking incident lead. good catch on KV thrash. after stabilization we should add tenant-level limits for long-context auto-batching and a guard on KV miss rate.
marie (oncall): noted. escalating to PM for quota/guard work. monitoring metrics and heatmaps.
ops-bot: Incident annotated with runbook steps and ticket #INC-20260317-001. reminder: create postmortem within 72h.
marie (oncall): handing off to day oncall @sahil in 10m. leaving channel. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Resolved? recent 2m window: p95 300ms, p99 420ms. please confirm stability before closing. :sparkles:
sahil: confirming stable for 5m with no new KV thrash spikes. collecting logs and will file post-incident notes + remediation tasks. moving to monitor state.
